verdict.summary: The pagination and saturation-guard changes remain correct and complete as scoped. Capped open-PR snapshots fail closed when saturated, and issue-deduplication paths exhaust REST pagination while flattening page arrays and excluding pull requests. The focused tests exercise the production call sites with saturated, below-cap, absent-marker, old-marker, and PR-only controls, so the assertions are non-vacuous. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found in this round.
